
```{r}
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 10
#| 



labels_place_type <- c(
                      "concert"            = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
                      "theatre/show"       = "Concert/Theatre/Show",
                      "darkroom"           = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
                      "sex-party"          = "Dark Room/Sex Party",
                      "dance-party"        = "Dance Party",
                      "sport-game"         = "Sport Game",
                      "private-residence-" = "Private Residence",
                      "something-else"     = "Something Else"
                    )

labels_place_sex <- c(
                      "no"            = "Social Contact",
                      "yes"           = "Sexual Contact"
                    )
  

labels_distance_from_home <- c("Same Neighborhood" = "Same neighborhood\nas home", "Same Borough" = "Same borough\nas home", "Different Borough" = "Different borough\nfrom home")

 working_data <- targets::tar_read(places_data) %>%
                       mutate(placeType = factor(placeType, names(labels_place_type), labels_place_type)) %>%
                       mutate(placeSex = factor(placeSex, names(labels_place_sex), labels_place_sex)) %>%
   mutate(distanceFromHome = factor(distanceFromHome, names(labels_distance_from_home), labels_distance_from_home))
 
figure_n_counts <-  working_data %>%
                                group_by(distanceFromHome, placeSex) %>%
                                summarize(n = n() )



plot <- working_data  %>%
  arrange(placeType, placeSex, distanceFromHome) %>%
  group_by(placeType, placeSex, distanceFromHome) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by( placeSex, distanceFromHome) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prop_label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 1)) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_bar(aes(x = placeType, y = proportion, fill = placeType), stat = "identity", width = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0, y = -0.8, label = paste("n =", n)), data = figure_n_counts, size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = prop_label, x = placeType, y = proportion + 0.4), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(placeSex ~ distanceFromHome , switch = "y") +
    coord_polar(clip = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = c(
                                      dark_blue, 
                                      light_blue, 
                                      dark_purple, 
                                      light_purple, 
                                      dark_pink, 
                                      light_pink, 
                                      light_green, 
                                      dark_green
                                      )
                      )    +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.text = element_text( hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 90),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0), hjust = 0), 
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(5, 0, 15, 0))
      ) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,0.25, 0.50, 1), limits = c(-0.8, 1)) +
    labs(
          title     = captions_and_titles("placesdistancesexcontact")$title,
          subtitle  = captions_and_titles("placesdistancesexcontact")$subtitle,
          caption   = captions_and_titles("placesdistancesexcontact")$caption %>% str_wrap(150) %>% paste0("\n\n", captions_and_titles("common_caption") )
          )

apply_style_spacing_place(plot)
```
